settings.cta_subheading: Choose a front cover and continue to secure checkout.

settings.heading: Quick answers before you write.
settings.body: Orders, setup and warranty in a few lines.

settings.question: How do I order Kevin?
settings.answer: Choose a front cover on the configure page and pay through secure Shopify checkout. Shipping is free across the EU, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Iceland.

settings.question: I need help with placement or the app.
settings.answer: Read the setup guide first. If you are still unsure, email us a photo of the room and the window and we will tell you where Kevin works best.

settings.question: My Kevin stopped working.
settings.answer: Kevin has a 3-year Swiss warranty. Email us the serial number on the bottom of the device and a short description, and we will arrange repair or replacement.

settings.question: Press or partnership request?
settings.answer: Email the press address for product photos, a fact sheet and interview availability.

settings.title: Orders and checkout
settings.body: Order confirmations and tracking numbers are sent by email as soon as Kevin ships. Returns are accepted within 30 days.

settings.title: Warranty repairs
settings.body: Send the serial number and a short description of the fault. We reply with the next step, usually a repair or a replacement unit.
